statusGroups.reason: Executable root native window and scene input boundary; no renderer, offscreen targets, embedded/multiple windows, GUI, theme, or content scaling. ADRs 0004, 0008, 0028.
First executable viewport rendering/canvas/texture and world integration after SDL3 GPU, with reduced fallback capabilities audited per member (ADRs 0008 and 0028).
First positional 2D audio integration with viewport ownership after the audio backend.
First typed GUI, text-input and embedded-viewport integration after rendering (ADRs 0008 and 0028).
Next viewport input/pointer slice and local-versus-parent input routing audit (ADR 0038); nested viewport ownership must be explicit.

Implemented root-window/input behavior is exercised by WindowRuntimeTests with dummy and Wayland. Full parity still depends on rendering, multiwindow, content scaling and GUI; native platform-specific requests retain DisplayServer limits. ADRs 0008, 0021 and 0028.
First viewport 2D picking/interpolation integration after Box2D.NET and the renderer (ADRs 0012 and 0028).
First typed GUI, text and theme integration with Window after the renderer (ADRs 0008 and 0028).
Next Window native-control projection and platform capability audit over the existing DisplayServer, including modes, flags, IME, native notifications and geometry (ADR 0040).
First rendered Window viewport, presentation and content-scaling slice; HDR requires a separate capability audit (ADR 0028).
First native multiwindow and embedded/popup viewport ownership slice after rendering; one root window exists today (ADRs 0008 and 0040).

Quit is deferred to the end of current execution, accepts an integer code defaulting to zero, and the latest accepted request determines the code returned by Engine.Run. Owner-thread callbacks and cross-thread ready quit are tested; manual hosts observe the returned MainLoop stop flag (ADRs 0004 and 0016).

Defaults true. Root close delivers CloseRequested first, then quits only if AutoAcceptQuit remains enabled and no explicit quit was requested; a handler can override the policy or exit code. WindowRuntimeTests exercises this on SDL dummy and native Wayland (ADRs 0004 and 0008).

MaxFps is executable Run cadence control with zero unlimited, runtime updates and unscaled monotonic waiting. Persistent ProjectSettings application/run/max_fps integration and presentation/VSync interaction await their explicit settings and rendering slices (ADRs 0016 and 0028).
